# Sagents LiveDebugger v0.4.1 - Table of Contents

A Phoenix LiveView dashboard for debugging and monitoring Sagents agents in real-time.

## Pages

- [Sagents Live Debugger](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [SagentsLiveDebugger](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.md): Real-time debugging and observability for agent systems.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.AgentListLive](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.AgentListLive.md)
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.CoreComponents](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.CoreComponents.md): Provides core UI components.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.FilterForm](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.FilterForm.md): Form schema for filtering and sorting agents in the dashboard.

- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Gettext](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Gettext.md): A module providing Internationalization with a gettext-based API.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Layouts](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Layouts.md)
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Live.Components.FilterConfig](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Live.Components.FilterConfig.md): Filter configuration component for auto-follow targeting.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Live.Components.MessageComponents](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Live.Components.MessageComponents.md): Shared components for rendering messages and tools.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Live.Components.SubagentsTab](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Live.Components.SubagentsTab.md): Component for displaying sub-agents in the debugger.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Metrics](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Metrics.md): Calculates system-wide metrics for active agents in the debugger.

- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Router](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Router.md): Router macro for mounting the debugger in a Phoenix application.
- [SagentsLiveDebugger.SessionConfig](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.SessionConfig.md): Provides on_mount callback to inject debugger configuration into LiveView socket.

- [SagentsLiveDebugger.Timezone](https://sagents-live-debugger.hexdocs.pm/SagentsLiveDebugger.Timezone.md): Helpers for validating IANA timezone strings received from the browser.
